root_cause.text: During the conversion to dynamic IDs for SM8450 interconnects, two link entries in the `qhs_compute_cfg` and `qhs_lpass_cfg` node definitions were left as obsolete static ID macros (which are not valid pointers) instead of being updated to point to the corresponding dynamic node structures, causing `icc_link_nodes()` to dereference a NULL pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `{ MASTER_CDSP_NOC_CFG }` to `{ &qhm_nsp_noc_config }` and `{ MASTER_CNOC_LPASS_AG_NOC }` to `{ &qhm_config_noc }`, with the commit message stating "two links unconverted" from the dynamic IDs conversion, and the crash backtrace showing `icc_link_nodes+0x3c` dereferencing a NULL pointer.
